brief:
Bank of Palestine and partner organizations launched a prostate cancer awareness campaign under the slogan "Awareness is Power," according to Maan Wire. The initiative seeks to increase public understanding of the disease, encourage screening, and promote early detection among men in Palestinian communities.

The coordinated effort reflects growing attention to prostate cancer prevention and health literacy in the region. Prostate cancer remains a significant health concern affecting Palestinian men, and awareness campaigns serve to inform the public about risk factors, symptoms, and the importance of regular medical checkups. The partnership between the financial institution and health-focused organizations underscores the role of the private sector in supporting public health initiatives.
title: Bank of Palestine launches prostate cancer awareness campaign
